name: bow yoga pose
description: A yoga backbend where you lie on your belly and hold your ankles. It stretches the thighs, chest and front of the hips.
instructions: Lie on your stomach with your arms along your sides.
Bend your knees and reach back to hold your ankles.
Lift your chest and kick your feet gently into your hands to raise your thighs.
Keep your gaze forward and breathe steadily.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then release slowly and rest on the mat.
